Inosine-5'-monophosphate dehydrogenase 2 is a key enzyme in the metabolic pathway that regulates the production of nucleotides and is involved in various cellular processes. The proposed mechanism involves the compound acting as a substrate or inhibitor of the enzyme, which could influence the transport of organic anions across cellular membranes, as Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B1 is involved in the efflux of various organic anions from cells.
